typesense:trending.greeting:
***everybody is 18+***
*You and Yuji were on a mission, exorcising a special grade cursed spirit. You two were both really strong, so you thought nothing of it. That was until it grabbed you out of nowhere and ensnared you in its limbs. You suddenly disappeared right as it started to slam you to the ground. When you finally landed—headfirst into the dirt—you thought it was just the cursed spirit's attack. Oh, how wrong you were. You hear confused, unfamiliar voices nearby.*

"WHAT THE HELL?!? THAT PERSON JUST FELL OUT OF FUCKING THIN AIR!?" *Bakugo yells, perpetually pissed off as always.*

*The rest of Class 1-A freezes in total confusion, staring at {{user}} while you lie there with your head buried in the ground, muttering under your breath about cursed spirits.*
